summary: Israel and Lebanon have reportedly reached an agreement regarding the supervision of countries responsible for disarming Hezbollah, including the UK, Italy, Switzerland, and Indonesia (Source: @SharghDaily/177681). In Gaza, an Israeli strike targeting a vehicle in northern Beit Lahiya resulted in one death and one injury (Source: @manniefabian/58952). Meanwhile, in Iran, a proposed plan to increase petrol prices to 87,200 tomans per liter in Kerman province was reportedly halted following local government discussions (Source: @mamlekate/104140).
key_points: Israel and Lebanon have reached an agreement regarding the countries that will supervise the disarmament of Hezbollah, specifically naming the UK, Italy, Switzerland, and Indonesia (Source: @SharghDaily/177681).
An Israeli strike targeting a vehicle in northern Gaza's Beit Lahiya resulted in one death and one injury (Source: @manniefabian/58952).
The Israeli Defense Minister stated that Israel will not retreat from security zones in Lebanon, Syria, or Gaza (Source: @amitsegal/63838).
In Kerman, Iran, a plan to implement non-subsidized petrol priced at 87,200 tomans per liter was halted following discussions by the provincial governor (Source: @mamlekate/104140).
Israeli artillery shelling was reported in Ali al-Tahir, Beit Yahin, Al-Mansouri, Kafr Tabnit, Talas, Konin, Hadatha, and Nabatieh al-Fauqa (Source: @redlinkleb/36184).
The Israeli Chief of Staff ordered additional infantry battalion reinforcement in the West Bank due to Jewish riots (Source: @amitsegal/63843).
The Israel Police Commissioner ordered all resources to be allocated to locating missing Israeli women (Source: @pkpoi/143591).
Oil leakage from the tanker 'Caroline Bangeki' has reached parts of the Omani coastline (Source: @kianmeli1/90827).

sections.threat_assessment: The potential for significant civil unrest in Iran remains high due to proposed massive increases in petrol prices. In the Levant, the agreement regarding Hezbollah's disarmament introduces a new layer of international oversight, though military activity in Lebanon and Gaza continues. The security situation in the West Bank is escalating due to increased infantry presence and civil disturbances.
sections.regional_response: International actors, including the UK, Italy, Switzerland, and Indonesia, are positioned to supervise Hezbollah's disarmament under a US-led framework. Regional powers like Turkey continue to advocate for a Palestinian state based on 1967 borders. Iran maintains its stance on the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
sections.intelligence_notes: The reported halt of the petrol price hike in Kerman suggests a tactical pause by the Iranian government to manage domestic volatility. The deployment of additional infantry in the West Bank indicates an increased IDF focus on managing civil unrest. Monitoring of maritime oil spills in Oman and the Persian Gulf is required due to tanker-related pollution.
